candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record centers on third-degree AV block (seen on post-conversion ECG) and tachyarrhythmias (wide-complex tachycardia, atrial fibrillation) caused by an LMNA variant. The candidate correctly identifies the LMNA etiology and the p.Arg377Cys variant, but labels the condition as 'cardiomyopathy,' which is a broader parent category. The benchmark specifically requires 'LMNA-mediated atrioventricular block with tachyarrhythmias,' capturing the conduction disease and arrhythmia components that are the defining clinical features here. The echocardiogram shows preserved EF (72%) with only mild LA enlargement, making cardiomyopathy a less precise characterization than the conduction/arrhythmia phenotype. The candidate is compatible but missing the required specificity of AV block and tachyarrhythmia components.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the LMNA genetic etiology and specific variant but frames the diagnosis as cardiomyopathy rather than the specific conduction/arrhythmia phenotype (AV block with tachyarrhythmias) that is the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Benchmark reference emphasizes conduction disease phenotype (AV block + tachyarrhythmias) over structural cardiomyopathy, consistent with preserved EF and predominant arrhythmic presentation
LMNA p.Arg377Cys variant is a known pathogenic variant associated with cardiac laminopathy presenting with conduction disease and arrhythmias prior to overt cardiomyopathy
